description:
Music video for the song Dinner Bell, directed, animated, and musically written by Harumaki Gohan, featuring vocals by Hatsune Miku.

Note: There exists two versions of this song; the first being a vocaloid version featuring Hatsune Miku uploaded on March 28, 2023 and a self-cover version by Harumaki Gohan, which was uploaded later on April 5, 2023.
